errors.text_span: Deutschland, Dänemark und die EU27 weisen jeweils etwa 7 Prozent auf.
errors.evidence: The description claims that Germany, Denmark, and EU27 each have a value of about 7%. While Germany and Denmark are at approximately 6.5%, the value for EU27 is much lower, at about 4.5%.
The description incorrectly states that there is no sorting, when the bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their value.
